question: What is the greatest number of Sundays that can occur in the first $49$ days of a year?
solution:
Since 49 = 7 × 7, divide the first 49 days into seven consecutive blocks of seven days each. Every block contains each weekday exactly once, regardless of which weekday starts the year. Thus there are always exactly seven Sundays, so seven is also the greatest possible number.
Final answer: 7
